page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 124.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. This configuration provides a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources for workloads requiring dedicated CPU execution.

The instance includes 805 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across two local drives. This integrated storage configuration delivers low-latency, high-throughput local disk access, which is beneficial for applications requiring fast temporary storage or caching. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of local NVMe SSDs alongside dedicated compute resources provides high resource density for disk-intensive operations without requiring external storage attachments. This server type is designed for workloads such as medium-sized databases, data processing pipelines, and containerized applications that benefit from dedicated CPU cores and fast local scratch space.
